objective.statement: Dissolve a stated trade-off instead of splitting it: find the option that gets both sides of the contradiction, or prove that no such option exists.
objective.charter: A contradiction framer states the trade-off FORMALLY - improving X currently degrades Y, and here is the mechanism by which it does. Five inventors then attack the mechanism, not the balance point. A compromise answer ('do 60% of X and 40% of Y') is REJECTED by construction: the whole point of this council is that a compromise means the contradiction was never dissolved. One inventive round only; if nothing dissolves it, hand the trade-off to an ordinary tradeoff council rather than grinding.
success_criteria: the contradiction is stated formally: improving X degrades Y, via a named mechanism
every compromise-shaped answer is rejected with the reason recorded
at least three genuinely non-compromise candidates were generated
either one candidate dissolves the contradiction, or impossibility is argued

context.briefing: State the contradiction as: improving X degrades Y BECAUSE <mechanism>. Without the mechanism there is nothing for an inventor to attack.
Ask which constraint is assumed rather than real. A relaxed false constraint dissolves more contradictions than cleverness does.
Classify every candidate: DISSOLVES or COMPROMISE. A candidate that trades X against Y at any ratio is a COMPROMISE and is out of scope here, however good it is.

sequence.custom_name: P29 formal contradiction statement: improving X degrades Y via a named mechanism
P31 constraint relaxation: for each constraint, ask whether it is real or assumed

all_of.producer: framer's contradiction card, checked by the methodologist for the presence of X, Y, and the degradation MECHANISM
all_of.note: DIAL 1 of 3. Without a named mechanism there is no target; the inventive round degenerates into ordinary brainstorming.

all_of.producer: methodologist's per-candidate DISSOLVES/COMPROMISE classification, with the rejection reason recorded per candidate
all_of.note: DIAL 2 of 3. Set the classifier to advisory if you want compromises kept as fallbacks - but then this is a tradeoff council, not a TRIZ one.
DIAL 3 of 3. Three non-compromise candidates is the floor for believing the space was probed at all. Bounded by targets.unique_ideas = 12.

any_of.note: The honest exit: the contradiction is real and irreducible. Take it to a tradeoff council instead of running a second inventive round here.

metadata.title: TRIZ contradiction council (8 seats, 45 minutes, one inventive round)
metadata.notes: WHEN TO USE: a trade-off someone has already tried to split and you suspect the split is the bug (fast AND thorough, cheap AND safe, autonomous AND supervised). WHEN NOT TO USE: as a general ideation council - the compromise veto makes it useless for balanced options - and never for a second round: the design mandates ONE inventive round, then fall through to a tradeoff protocol. That deliberate under-persistence is the anti-grind control, so protocol.rounds.min is 1. The design's named dial is contradiction_pair. EDITABLE DIALS: /objective/statement (state YOUR X and Y), /stopping/expression/any_of/0/all_of/2/value (candidates required), /voting/veto/holders (drop the methodologist veto to allow compromises), /budgets/time_minutes. STOPPING (human form): ALL[custom:contradiction_stated_formally == true, custom:compromise_answers_rejected == true, novel_ideas >= 3] OR proof_of_impossibility == true. source_expression absent per the SEM-001/SEM-012 collision proven by _probe_sem_rule_collision.py.
